description: This file defines an immutable Java class named 'Secret' that models a secret with a name and value, provides factory methods for creation, and methods to access and convert to configuration format.

classes.name: Secret
classes.description: An immutable class representing a secret with a name and value, capable of converting itself to a configuration object.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new Secret instance with specified key and value.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the secret.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the secret.

methods.name: toConfig
methods.description: Converts the Secret into a Config object with 'name' and 'value' entries.
